bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_DEPLOY_MAPPING_READONLY\n'
printf 'PROJECT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'PROJECT_REF='; git symbolic-ref -q --short HEAD || true
printf 'PROJECT_STATUS_PATHS\n'; git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=normal | cut -c4-
printf 'PROJECT_DIFF_STAT\n'; git diff --stat || true
printf 'COMMIT_SUMMARY='; git log -1 --format='%s'
printf 'RELEVANT_TREE_PATHS\n'; git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD | grep -E '(^deploy/|creatorPolling|paidVideoOptimize|docker-compose|compose\.ya?ml|src/)' | head -55 || true
printf 'PARENT_FILES\n'; find .. -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*videobot*compose*.yaml' -o -name 'compose.videobot*.yaml' -o -name 'docker-compose*.yml' \) -print | head -35 || true
printf 'CURRENT_POLL_COMPOSE_LABELS\n'; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format 'image={{.Image}} project={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} config={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}} workdir={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}}'
printf 'POLL_ENV_KEY_NAMES\n'; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | cut -d= -f1 | grep -E 'VIDEOBOT_|CREATEVDOBOT_|NODE_ENV|DATABASE_' | sort
printf 'POLL_MOUNT_DESTINATIONS\n'; docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination}}{{end}}'
printf 'LOCAL_API_CONTAINER_COUNT='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ec 'telegram-bot-api|local-bot-api' || true
printf 'VIDEO_SOURCE_SHA_AVAILABLE='; if git cat-file -e 081bde33eba03a1409dbd2f4bbf4d08233e8d40d^{commit} 2>/dev/null; then printf yes; else printf no; fi; printf '\n'
